content:
SmartSites is a full-service digital marketing agency. They are experts in Search Engine optimization and Pay-Per-Click advertising. Now, it assists businesses to scale through a combination of long-term organic growth and immediate paid traffic generation. It has managed more than USD 500 million in paid advertising spend. In turn, SmartSites has earned multiple consistent rankings on the Inc. 5000 list. They are a one-stop agency for SEO, paid media, and web design.

How do they work?

SmartSites's working process includes:

  1. Discovery and Strategy Planning - SmartSites starts with a detailed audit of a company’s website, account advice, and the competitor landscape. In turn, teams find high-intent keywords, technical website issues, and paid advertising opportunities. 
  2. Technical Setup - SmartSites’ developers optimize website speed, mobile optimization, and technical SEO structure. 
  3. Campaign Launch- Next, they start paid campaigns. It can be done through Google Ads, Meta, or other platforms. 
  4. Continuous Optimization- SmartSites's teams work on A/B testing. It's done for everything, including ads, landing pages, and conversion funnels. 
  5. Reporting and Performance Reviews- Eventually, clients get transparent dashboards. It clearly shows clicks, impressions, leads, conversions, and ROI metrics.

Core Capabilities

SmartSites’ core capabilities include web development, organic search, and PPC.

Advanced Web Design and Development

SmartSites makes conversion-focused websites. In fact, it uses WordPress, Shopify, and custom frameworks.

Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

It uses technical SEO audits to identify crawl errors, indexing issues, and similar content. 

Paid Media Management (PPC)

The agency manages paid campaigns on search engines and social media.

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

SmartSites’ design custom landing pages for paid traffic campaigns. 

What makes SmartSites stand out?

  • Idea Industry Reputation- SmartSites has more than 1,000 verified 5-star reviews on Clutch, G2, and Trustpilot. 
  • Tier-1 Platform Collabs- The agency is a Google Premier Partner. 
  • Unified SEO- SmartSites combines organic SEO and paid advertising in one strategy. It helps in long-term search visibility and immediate lead generation. 
  • Conversion-Focused Execution: It focuses on measurable ROI rather than vanity metrics such as impressions.

Key Services

  • Organic SEO Services- Clients can do both technical SEO auditing and optimization. At the same time, they work on Local SEO, Google Business Profile management, E-commerce SEO for Shopify, etc. 
  • Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising: Smartsites is an expert in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads management, Display Advertising, YouTube campaigns, and more. 
  • Website Design and Development- It plays a key role in SEO growth. This includes custom business website development and website redesign.
  • Paid Social Media Marketing: SmartSites handles paid Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn ad management.
  • Analytics and Tracking - It implements advanced Google Analytics 4, event tracking, call tracking, and real-time reporting dashboards to track ROI.

Advanced Capabilities

  • AI-Driven Marketing Workflows - SmartSites integrates AI to target potential leads. At the same time, it uses machine learning models to know potential customer behavior.
  • Multi-Channel Lifecycle Automation- The agency automates email, SMS, and customer retention workflows. 
  • Enterprise CRM and API Integrations- It directly integrates their campaigns with popular CRMs.
  • Predictive Audience Tracking- SmartSites uses historical data and behavioral analysis. This helps to enhance ad targeting and find a high-value audience for conversion.

Who should work with SmartSites?

  • Local Service Businesses- HVAC, Plumbing, roofing, regional medical clinics, and home services.
  • E-Commerce Brands- Shopify, WooCommerce, DTC retail brands, online stories, etc.
  • Mid-Market Businesses- Companies with a growing marketing budget or companies scaling beyond basic SEO
  • Multi-Location Companies- Franchise networks, regional service providers, and businesses expanding into new regions 

Best-fit Industries

SmartSites works best in industries driven by strong search intent and high-value customer acquisition.

  • Financial and Consulting Services 
  • E-commerce and Retail 
  • Multi-location businesses
  • Healthcare 
  • Home and Commercial services 
  • Legal Services 
  • Industrial and B2B distribution

Key Use Cases

  • Scaling Lead Generation- The agency increases inbound calls from submissions and appointment bookings.
  • Recovering Wasted Ad Spend- It reduces irrelevant clicks and negative keywords. This helps to improve Google or Meta Campaigns.
  • Local Market Expansion- SmartSites supports regional companies expanding into new territories. So, they use location-specific landing pages and localized SEO campaigns.
  • E-Commerce Revenue Growth- The agency enables retail brands using shopping ads, retargeting, and SEO to increase online sales.

Pros 

  • Strong local SEO and e-commerce marketing 
  • Expert in SEO and PPC under one roof
  • Designs conversion-focused landing page and website designs
  • 1,000+ verified 5-star client reviews 
  • Google Premier Partner and Meta Business Partner status 
  • Transparent pricing with no major setup fee

Considerations 

  • A few users reported onboarding and setup delays 
  • SEO retainers could be expensive for small brands 
  • Organic SEO results take 3-6 months to appear

Top Alternatives

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • WebFX- Expert in AI-powered analytics and large-scale marketing 
  • KlientBoost- Impressive conversion-focused performance marketing 
  • Thrive Internet Marketing Agency- Exceptional Flexible full-service digital marketing agency
  • Ignite Visibility- Multi-Channel digital marketing agency

Final Words

SmartSites is a leading digital marketing agency. They are best for companies that aim to scale SEO and PPC growth. They use SEO, PPC, web design, and advanced analytics to bring results. Looking to transform your business and scale growth? An ideal partner like SmartSites, helps you get there
